# Allowlist for leak-scan.sh: one Perl regex per line, matched against `<path>:<match>`.
# Keep every entry generic or upstream-owned. Never add a real machine, user or address of ours.

# Placeholder home directories in docs, tests and examples.
:/(home|Users)/(user|u|me|you|name|someone|alice|bob|example|runner)/$

# Homebrew's Linux prefix is a fixed path, not a person.
:/home/linuxbrew/$

# Upstream's recorded terminal sessions, their goldens and snapshots carry its authors' paths.
:/home/(aram|thomas|jinho)/$
^src/tests/fixtures/
^zellij-terminal/fixtures/goldens/
/snapshots/[^:]*\.snap:

# Sample addresses already in tests, each pinned to its file.
^default-plugins/session-manager/src/main\.rs:10\.0\.0\.7$
^zellij-utils/src/desktop_integration/platform\.rs:10\.0\.0\.[12]$
^zellij-utils/src/input/cli_assets\.rs:192\.168\.1\.[25]$
